description: Main roster table of the 陸軍現役将校同相当官実役停年名簿 大正15年9月1日調, narrow-column pages: the 尉官 sections, listed by regiment (近衛歩兵第一聯隊中尉, 歩兵第三十三聯隊少尉), 13 strips per leaf. A section opens with a section-label column and a legend column inside the table, and a leaf may be ruled but unused (frame 250's right leaf is an empty table) - strips that hold no officer are what roster_cell.audit_status='extra_row' is for. Same seven bands as the wide pages, the lower ones ruled lower. A camera scan of the bound book.

provenance.method: Rulings detected per leaf on the camera-scan path of reading/registration.py. A leaf was admitted only if it carried all six interior rulings of this layout within 0.012: the left leaf of frame 350, both leaves of 450, the right leaf of 550. Pooled fractions clustered at 0.015, band = cluster median; every band has support 4/4 and spread <= 0.0012. Outer bands are the table frame, 0.0 and 1.0. Differs from the wide template only in the two lowest interior rulings, 0.018 and 0.013 lower in the table - more than this template's tolerance, so each page registers to one of the two. Not admitted: frame 250 (the right leaf is an empty ruled table and lost the 0.639 ruling; the left leaf, which carries the officers, gave only 4 rulings), 350 right (lost 0.780), 550 left (lost 0.639).
provenance.field_labels: Read from the legend column printed inside the table on frames 250 and 350: 現官ノ實役停年 / 列次 / 任官ノ年月日 / 出身期別 / 職名、命課ノ年月日 / 本邦位、勳、功、爵、學位 外國勳章 / 氏名 with 年齡 between. Carried band for band to the wide template of this edition. Nobody has confirmed any label.

match.note: Measured 10 Sep 2026 against every cached 1923, 1926, 1933 and 1935 leaf. Accepted: frame 250 right leaf (an empty ruled table - its 13 strips are for the reader to mark extra_row), both leaves of 350, 450 and 550 - 7-8 of 8 bands, all 100% explained. Rejected: 250 left leaf, which carries that section's officers, with only 4 rulings found - a known miss. required_bands [2, 3] as on the wide template. The wide pages score 6/8 here (see the wide template). No Shōwa leaf matches more than 5 of 8 or is more than 50% explained.

columns.note: Nominal count only, never a gate: 13 strips per leaf including section-label, legend and unused strips; 12-13 detected. Officer index 0 is the rightmost strip.

fields.name: service_in_rank
fields.note: 現官ノ實役停年 (legend) - elapsed service in the current rank as 年、月、日, e.g. 二、八、一八 on frame 350. NOT a date: do not parse with reading/eradate.py. Printed once and dittoed 同 along the officers who share it.

fields.name: seniority_no
fields.note: 列次 (legend) - Arabic numerals. Within a regiment's section they ascend right-to-left with wide gaps (frame 350: 1505, 1525, 1603 ... 2830), because the number is the place in the whole rank. Some carry a small circled mark before the number (⊖1505) - meaning not established.

fields.name: appointment_dates
fields.note: 任官ノ年月日 (legend) - ONE cell holding every appointment, each date tagged with the rank it conferred (大正九、一二、二五少尉 / 同一二、一二、五中尉). The schema's commissioning_date is the line tagged 少尉 inside it. Not a single date: do not parse the cell with eradate; deliberately not mapped to commissioning_date.

fields.name: cohort
fields.note: 出身期別 (legend) - class of origin: an Arabic number (32-37 on frame 350) or a number with a small 少 (5少, 4少, 2少 on frame 350). The plain numbers are presumably the 陸軍士官学校 期; what the 少 forms denote is for the lead. No observation column; binning's numeric reading will refuse the 少 forms rather than drop the mark.

fields.name: post
fields.note: 職名、命課ノ年月日 (legend) - the assignment (聯隊附, 陸軍歩兵學校教導隊附), with the date of the posting in small type at the foot where one is printed.

fields.name: court_rank_decorations
fields.note: 本邦位、勳、功、爵、學位 / 外國勳章 (legend) - e.g. 正八、旭七、瑞六; 從七. No observation column.

fields.name: name_raw
fields.note: 氏名 (legend) in large type, with 年齡 in small type beneath: AGE as 年、月 at the 調 date (三〇、四 for a 少尉), NOT a birth date. See the wide template of this edition for the cross-edition check. The figures stay in the name proposal; the reader separates them.
